problem: P1 needs exact-head movement artifacts from the trusted HTML5 CI workflow, but changing that workflow inside the player-facing P1 PR crosses the governance trust boundary and correctly makes the feature PR unmergeable.

decision.rationale: Move the HTML5 movement-evidence workflow capability into a dedicated process PR. The workflow emits a not-applicable movement artifact on source revisions without the P1 producer, and automatically executes the full movement capture once that producer exists. This keeps the governance change independently mergeable without weakening exact-head evidence.

findings: The process split removes the governance-authority file from the P1 feature diff without reducing movement evidence.
The producer-presence guard prevents the process PR itself from depending on unmerged P1 code.

governance.trust_boundary_change: The canonical HTML5 CI workflow gains an optional movement-evidence producer path. It remains read-only and exact-source bound; no candidate gains authority over trusted evidence validation.
governance.bypass_analysis: Movement capture is skipped only when its producer does not exist on the exact source revision, and a retained not-applicable artifact records that fact. Once P1 producer exists, missing movement files are fatal. Required trusted/base checks, workflow permissions and evidence validators are unchanged.
governance.rollback: Revert this workflow and manifest. Existing foundation visual/storage/playable evidence returns to the pre-movement behavior; game runtime and saved data are unaffected.

known_limitations: The movement artifact is intentionally not-applicable until a source revision contains the P1 movement QA producer.
